stores_slug_format.name: stores_slug_format
stores_slug_format.value: length("slug") BETWEEN 3 AND 63 AND "slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND "slug" NOT GLOB '-*' AND "slug" NOT GLOB '*-'

menu_items_image_key_store.name: menu_items_image_key_store
menu_items_image_key_store.value: "image_object_key" IS NULL OR (length("image_object_key") <= 200 AND substr("image_object_key", 1, length('stores/' || "store_id" || '/menu/')) = 'stores/' || "store_id" || '/menu/')

payment_fees_card_mode.name: payment_fees_card_mode
payment_fees_card_mode.value: ("method" = 'credit' AND "card_mode" IN ('normal', 'rapido')) OR ("method" = 'pix' AND "card_mode" IS NULL)

store_operation_settings_pause_actor.name: store_operation_settings_pause_actor
store_operation_settings_pause_actor.value: ("paused" = 0 AND "paused_at" IS NULL AND "paused_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "paused_by_role" IS NULL) OR ("paused" = 1 AND "paused_at" IS NOT NULL AND "paused_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "paused_by_role" IS NOT NULL)

store_operation_settings_fixed_fee.name: store_operation_settings_fixed_fee
store_operation_settings_fixed_fee.value: ("delivery_fixed_fee_cents" IS NULL OR "delivery_fixed_fee_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 100000000) AND ("delivery_mode" IS NOT 'fixed' OR "delivery_fixed_fee_cents" IS NOT NULL)

store_operation_settings_delivery_eta.name: store_operation_settings_delivery_eta
store_operation_settings_delivery_eta.value: ("delivery_eta_min_minutes" IS NULL AND "delivery_eta_max_minutes" IS NULL) OR ("delivery_eta_min_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND "delivery_eta_max_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND "delivery_eta_min_minutes" <= "delivery_eta_max_minutes")

store_operation_settings_pickup_eta.name: store_operation_settings_pickup_eta
store_operation_settings_pickup_eta.value: ("pickup_eta_min_minutes" IS NULL AND "pickup_eta_max_minutes" IS NULL) OR ("pickup_eta_min_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND "pickup_eta_max_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND "pickup_eta_min_minutes" <= "pickup_eta_max_minutes")

order_status_events_actor.name: order_status_events_actor
order_status_events_actor.value: ("actor_user_id" IS NULL AND "actor_role" IS NULL) OR ("actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "actor_role" IN ('owner', 'operator'))

orders_delivery_street.name: orders_delivery_street
orders_delivery_street.value: "delivery_street" IS NULL OR length("delivery_street") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

orders_delivery_number.name: orders_delivery_number
orders_delivery_number.value: "delivery_number" IS NULL OR length("delivery_number") BETWEEN 1 AND 20

orders_delivery_complement.name: orders_delivery_complement
orders_delivery_complement.value: "delivery_complement" IS NULL OR length("delivery_complement") BETWEEN 1 AND 120

orders_delivery_reference.name: orders_delivery_reference
orders_delivery_reference.value: "delivery_reference" IS NULL OR length("delivery_reference") BETWEEN 1 AND 160

orders_delivery_neighborhood.name: orders_delivery_neighborhood
orders_delivery_neighborhood.value: "delivery_neighborhood" IS NULL OR length("delivery_neighborhood") BETWEEN 1 AND 120

orders_address_by_fulfillment.name: orders_address_by_fulfillment
orders_address_by_fulfillment.value: ("fulfillment" = 'delivery' AND "delivery_street" IS NOT NULL AND "delivery_number" IS NOT NULL AND "delivery_neighborhood" IS NOT NULL AND "delivery_fee_mode" IS NOT NULL) OR ("fulfillment" = 'pickup' AND "delivery_postal_code" IS NULL AND "delivery_street" IS NULL AND "delivery_number" IS NULL AND "delivery_complement" IS NULL AND "delivery_reference" IS NULL AND "delivery_neighborhood" IS NULL AND "delivery_fee_mode" IS NULL AND "delivery_fee_cents" = 0)

orders_note.name: orders_note
orders_note.value: "note" IS NULL OR length("note") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

orders_eta.name: orders_eta
orders_eta.value: ("eta_min_minutes" IS NULL AND "eta_max_minutes" IS NULL) OR ("eta_min_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND "eta_max_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND "eta_min_minutes" <= "eta_max_minutes")

phone_lookups_found.name: phone_lookups_found
phone_lookups_found.value: ("result" = 'found' AND "matched_order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "confirm_token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "confirm_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("result" <> 'found' AND "matched_order_id" IS NULL AND "confirm_token_hash" IS NULL AND "confirm_expires_at" IS NULL AND "confirmed_at" IS NULL)
